LanguageData.HD_BreachExplosive_InstallFuse_Desc: Consume one igniter and install C-4 on a wall or door with time blasting fuse. The operator remains linked within {0} cells until the charge is fired or abandoned. C-4 use scales with the structure's current hit points, and installation time scales with the amount of C-4 used.
LanguageData.HD_BreachExplosive_InstallShockTube_Desc: Consume one igniter and install C-4 on a wall or door with non-electric shock tube. Wiring takes 20% longer, but the operator may move within {0} cells until the charge is fired or abandoned. C-4 use scales with the structure's current hit points, and installation time scales with the amount of C-4 used.
LanguageData.HD_BreachExplosive_Detonate_Desc: Spend one second firing the installed C-4. A shock tube detonates immediately afterward; time fuse burns for one additional second per cell between the operator and the charge.
LanguageData.HD_BreachExplosive_Abandon_Desc: Cut the connection and abandon the installed charge. The installed C-4 will not be recovered.
LanguageData.HD_BreachExplosive_OperatorUnavailable: The operator cannot install or fire a breaching charge right now.
LanguageData.HD_BreachExplosive_InvalidTarget: Select an impassable wall or a door.
LanguageData.HD_BreachExplosive_AlreadyLinked: This operator is already linked to an installed breaching charge.
LanguageData.HD_BreachExplosive_WallAlreadyCharged: This structure already has a breaching charge installed.
LanguageData.HD_BreachExplosive_MissingIgniter: The required igniter is no longer in the operator's inventory.
LanguageData.HD_BreachExplosive_NoC4: Requires at least {0} C-4 in the operator's inventory.
LanguageData.HD_BreachExplosive_CannotReach: Cannot reach a suitable installation position beside the structure.
LanguageData.HD_BreachExplosive_CannotReserve: The selected wall is already reserved.
LanguageData.HD_BreachExplosive_ChargeInvalid: The installed charge has lost its target structure.
LanguageData.HD_BreachExplosive_OutOfRange: The operator must be within {0} cells of the installed charge.
LanguageData.HD_BreachExplosive_Installed: Installed {0} C-4. Movement is now limited to a {1}-cell radius until detonation or abandonment.
LanguageData.HD_BreachExplosive_Abandoned: The breaching charge was abandoned and its C-4 was lost.
LanguageData.HD_BreachExplosive_TetherBlocked: Cannot move beyond the breaching charge's {0}-cell connection range. Detonate or abandon the charge first.
LanguageData.HD_BreachExplosive_FuseLit: The time fuse is burning. Detonation in {0} seconds.
